products.title: Velvet & Gold Cut-Out Gown
products.description: A black velvet bodice cut into a sharp asymmetric line, flowing into a molten gold skirt that falls straight to the floor. Architectural and unapologetically glamorous. Add a wide-brim hat and you are the editorial.

products.title: White Halter Ruffle Gown
products.description: A high halter neckline and a fitted white bodice that breaks into an asymmetric cascade of ruffles. Bridal-adjacent, pure and dramatic. Picture it at a white party, an engagement shoot or your birthday dinner.

products.title: Cobalt Draped Jumpsuit
products.description: Cobalt blue with sheer long sleeves and a sweeping drape that wraps from the shoulder across the body. From the front it reads like a gown; underneath, the ease of trousers. Elegance you can actually move in.

products.title: Cobalt Mesh-Sleeve Draped Gown
products.description: Royal cobalt with sheer mesh sleeves, a gathered bodice and a draped sash that sweeps into a flared hem. Regal, covered and full of movement. The gown for a church anniversary, a wedding or a family celebration.

products.title: White Wide-Leg & Floral Bustier Set
products.description: Crisp white wide-leg trousers, a floral halter bustier and a sheer white overshirt. A fresh, fashion-forward three-part look for brunch, a boat day or a white-themed party.

products.title: Bronze Draped Keyhole Gown
products.description: A shimmering bronze pattern, a keyhole neckline and long sleeves, with a dramatic drape gathered across the hip. It comes with its inner, so you can wear it with total confidence. Old-Hollywood glamour, Lagos style.

products.title: Ivory Cowl Mermaid Gown
products.description: Ivory draped into a deep cowl neckline, ruched through the hips and released into a mermaid hem. Soft, sculptural and luminous. Imagine it at a traditional wedding reception or a candlelit dinner.

products.title: Midnight Cowl Mermaid Gown
products.description: Deep midnight indigo with a soft cowl neckline, long sleeves and a hem that spreads into a small train. Mysterious and grown-up. The gown for evenings when you want quiet, undeniable elegance.

products.title: White Off-Shoulder Drape Gown
products.description: A luminous white column with an off-shoulder neckline and a long draped panel that trails behind you. Clean lines, soft sheen, serious presence. For white parties, bridal events and elegant evenings.

products.title: Fuchsia & Print Mermaid Gown
products.description: A fuchsia off-shoulder bodice set against a bold printed mermaid skirt. Joyful, colourful and proudly statement. Wear it to an owambe and watch the photographers find you.

products.title: Cerise Rosette Mini Dress
products.description: A sweetheart neckline, short sleeves and a skirt built from layers of sculpted rosette ruffles. Flirty, romantic and made for celebration. Your birthday dress has entered the chat.

products.title: Ruched Cut-Out Column Gown
products.description: A sculpted cut-out neckline, long sleeves and all-over ruching with ruffled edges that trace your silhouette to the floor. It is the definition of body-confident. Choose cobalt to stand out, black to own the night or red to do both.

products.title: Rust Ruched Wrap Maxi
products.description: Warm rust with a wrap V-neck, long sleeves and ruching that shapes every curve down to the ankle. Rich colour, flattering lines and easy to accessorise with gold. A festive-season favourite in the making.

products.title: Red Cut-Out Twist Maxi
products.description: A red maxi with a sculpted cut-out neckline, long sleeves and a twisted gather at the hip. Sleek, sensual and sure of itself. Red lipstick optional, compliments guaranteed.

products.title: Red Twist-Front Slit Maxi
products.description: A clean red maxi with long sleeves, a twisted front and a front slit that shows just enough. Elegant enough for church, bold enough for dinner.

products.title: Turquoise Off-Shoulder Ruched Maxi
products.description: Bright turquoise with a soft off-shoulder neckline and ruching that sculpts through the hips before falling to the floor. Fresh, vibrant and holiday-ready.

products.title: Turquoise Cut-Out Pleated Maxi
products.description: A cut-out neckline and fitted long-sleeve bodice meet a softly pleated skirt that floats as you walk. Graceful and bright, it looks beautiful in motion.

products.title: Royal Blue Plunge Maxi
products.description: Royal blue with a deep plunge, long sleeves, a cut-out waist and a skirt that pours to the floor. Bold neckline, fluid movement, total presence.

products.title: White Ruffle-Front Ruched Maxi
products.description: Delicate straps, a ruched white body and a line of ruffles running down the centre. Soft and romantic with a body-hugging shape. Perfect for white-themed parties and summer evenings.

products.title: Polka Dot Long-Sleeve Maxi
products.description: A tiny polka dot print on a long-sleeve maxi with a gently flared skirt. Classic, modest and quietly stylish. Wear it to church, the office or a family lunch.

products.title: Fuchsia Off-Shoulder Drape Gown
products.description: Vivid fuchsia with an off-shoulder neckline, long sleeves and a draped panel that falls from the hip. Photogenic from every angle. The colour of celebration.

products.title: Blue Print One-Shoulder Maxi
products.description: A blue and green print draped over one shoulder and wrapped close to the body. Artful, fluid and full of life. Holiday dinners and garden parties, this one is for you.

products.title: Black Lace-Sleeve Ruched Mini
products.description: A ruched black mini with a cut-out neckline and sheer lace sleeves. Sensual, curve-loving and made for night. Add red heels and a small bag and the look is complete.

products.title: Tiered Strappy Midi Dress
products.description: Thin straps, a gathered bodice and a tiered skirt that swings below the knee. Light, feminine and easy. In red for joy, in black for evening.

products.title: Violet Cut-Out Jumpsuit
products.description: Deep violet with long sleeves, circular cut-outs at the neckline and wide legs that sweep the floor. Chic, comfortable and completely striking.

products.title: Red Keyhole Jumpsuit
products.description: A fitted red jumpsuit with keyhole cut-outs, long sleeves and flared legs. One zip, one look, all confidence. From the office to dinner without changing a thing.

products.title: Colour-Block Tiered Mini Dress
products.description: Fuchsia, orange and blush tiers with flutter sleeves. Happy, breezy and effortlessly fun. Sunglasses on, shoulder bag ready, weekend unlocked.
details: Fuchsia, orange and blush colour block

products.title: Olive Ruched Bodycon Midi
products.description: A rich olive midi with a V-neck and ruching from bust to hem that celebrates every curve. Unexpected colour, flawless fit.

products.title: Red Ruched Tie-Sleeve Mini
products.description: A red ruched mini with a V-neck and long sleeves finished with trailing ties. Flirty, fitted and fun to move in.

products.title: Red Sweetheart Ruched Mini
products.description: A sweetheart neckline, long sleeves and deep ruching in bold red. Short, sculpting and made for a night out.
